q: `git rebase main` is interrupted by conflicts. You resolve the first conflict but run `git rebase --continue` and see another conflict. Why?
options: Rebase applies commits one by one, conflicts may appear multiple times

q: You run `git cherry-pick <commit>` from another branch. You get a conflict. What happens if you resolve and commit?
options: The commit is applied to current branch

q: Given `git branch` shows only main. You run `git checkout -b feature`. What is the result?
options: New branch feature created and checked out
